release_gates: Python compilation and full unit tests pass
source self-test and bilingual UI self-test pass
Agnes readiness requires the current credential and explicit free confirmation
changing/removing the Agnes credential invalidates old live-route proof
a ready Hermes Managed Local lane is not blocked by a missing Agnes key
Resume UI stays disabled without both a resumable task and exact live-route proof
empty explicit environment mappings never inherit process credentials or routing flags
ambient process AGNES_API_KEY cannot override the isolated FirstWindow profile credential
real Hermes -> Agnes API readiness/task execution is attested with actual API usage
task outcome remains unverified until independent acceptance evidence exists
Windows package build, packaged self-test, packaged UI self-test, and SHA-256 generation pass
public README/site pass release-surface truth regression tests
PR CI and Windows App pass on the release-candidate commit
verified main passes CI and Windows App before v0.4.1 tag publication
release includes EXE plus machine-readable SHA-256 checksum and downloaded checksum re-verifies
invariants: $0 Mode never silently falls back to unknown-cost providers
Hermes Agent is the primary executor; Agnes API is a provider lane configured inside an isolated Hermes profile; direct Agnes CLI is advanced/manual only
worker output or exit code is not final task acceptance evidence
FirstWindow never clones general Hermes provider credentials into its isolated profile
credentials are never stored in FirstWindow task state
Start/Resume requires a live probe proof for the exact route fingerprint
agent tool cwd must remain pinned to the selected project
shutdown, restart, sleep, and power actions are out of scope
one primary engineering issue per implementation branch
verified-complete tasks must not be resumed automatically
only one materially distinct launch experiment is active at a time
stars, visits, downloads, and comments are signals rather than proof of product quality
fake engagement, spam, fabricated evidence, and deceptive launch claims are prohibited
